title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / Bold and Bold Italic
slide_intent: Judge bold and bold italic in real words and paragraphs so weight and slant can be chosen for both voice and reading.
strategic_value: The bold and bold italic specimens can help Helsinki retain a consistent family while selecting an appropriate degree of emphasis.
demonstration: A two-column specimen combines Cyrillic words and a Ukrainian paragraph with large Cyrillic forms.
practical_value: Compare the bold and bold italic cuts at display and paragraph scale before assigning them to a communication.

content_islands.name: Word specimens
content_islands.spec: Large words demonstrate the selected upright and italic cuts.

content_islands.name: Paragraph and large forms
content_islands.spec: A smaller paragraph and oversized letter or numeral forms provide contrasting reading scales.
